scope: All evidenced G-02 Kaggle dataset, kernel-startup, input-mount, transport, and parity failures through 2026-07-30.

families.name: REMOTE_SOURCE_REGISTRATION_DRIFT
families.signature: Kernel metadata omits a locally declared dataset source.
families.prevention: Pull or attest remote kernel metadata and require exact dataset_sources equality before accepting a run.

incidents.error: KernelError: missing or ambiguous dataset onebitbrain/trackastra-h1-fit105-cache-v1

families.name: WORKING_PATH_ARTIFACT_OMISSION
families.signature: Launcher expects a file under /kaggle/working that it never copied.
families.prevention: Preflight every source-to-working copy and authenticate both source and destination before Stage A.

incidents.error: cache_dataset_manifest.json absent from its /kaggle/working contract path

families.name: UNUSED_OPTIONAL_DEPENDENCY_ON_LAUNCH_PATH
families.signature: Packaged source imports an unavailable optional dependency before useful work.
families.prevention: Run an isolated import smoke with optional packages explicitly blocked; scientific code_file must not import unused sweep modules.

incidents.error: optional tracksdata dependency imported through an unused sweep module

families.name: CROSS_PLATFORM_EXACT_PARITY_DRIFT
families.signature: Remote Linux/Python/PyTorch result differs byte-for-byte from a local exact reference.
families.prevention: Run and retain a one-video remote parity diagnostic before any full-population pass; exactness changes require a new contract.

incidents.error: v2 numerical parity with v1 failed for row_features

families.name: HEAVY_IMPORT_BEFORE_AUTHENTICATED_STEP0
families.signature: Unavailable or heavy package imports before required inputs and offline wheels are checked.
families.prevention: Static guard rejects NumPy/Torch/zarr/scipy/tracksdata imports before the STEP0 assignment.

incidents.error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'zarr'

families.name: REQUIRED_WEIGHT_ABSENT_FROM_MOUNT
families.signature: The kernel starts and installs dependencies before discovering that the pinned checkpoint is absent.
families.prevention: Step 0 must resolve exactly one checkpoint by pinned SHA and size before pip or heavy imports.

families.name: SPLIT_INPUT_BUNDLE_OMITS_REQUESTS
families.signature: Checkpoint authenticates but the separately managed request dataset is absent or empty.
families.prevention: Checkpoint, request manifest, positive request count, population manifest, and wheels must share one content-addressed bundle for the consumer lane.

incidents.error: FeatureError: no frozen feature requests found

families.name: DATASET_CLI_NESTED_DIRECTORY_OMISSION
families.signature: Dataset version is READY but nested request files were skipped during CLI packaging.
families.prevention: Build a flat or archived transport, enumerate the uploaded inventory, and require a remote round-trip receipt before launch.

incidents.error: Kaggle CLI skipped the nested request directory

families.name: MUTABLE_SHARED_DATASET_WRONG_CARRIER
families.signature: Multiple lanes reuse one dataset slug, so latest-version attachment exposes the wrong carrier.
families.prevention: A dataset source is owned by exactly one lane; temporary CPU carriers use dedicated immutable slugs.

incidents.error: Step0InputError: bundle manifest content resolution expected one match, found 0
incidents.evidence: At launch the shared CELLECT slug's latest version was DINOv2 carrier v8.

families.name: SIBLING_MODULE_NOT_PACKAGED
families.signature: Kaggle packages code_file but not an imported sibling Python file.
families.prevention: Scientific code_file must be self-contained; static guard rejects imports matching sibling .py files.

incidents.error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'kaggle_selector_step0'

families.name: TRANSPORT_REENCODING_PLATFORM_BYTE
families.signature: A reversible gzip check changes only the gzip OS header byte under Python 3.12.
families.prevention: Normalize the deterministic gzip OS byte before comparing the frozen compressed SHA; regression-test Python-version variance.

incidents.error: Step0Error: expanded gzip transport is not byte-reversible

families.name: BROAD_LAZY_MOUNT_TRAVERSAL_IN_STEP0
families.signature: Recursive discovery or full mounted-payload hashing violates the five-second envelope.
families.prevention: No rglob, ** glob, or full-payload inventory hashing in step 0; use exact roots plus small manifest/inventory hashes and pinned sizes.

incidents.error: step 0 exceeded the five-second fail-closed envelope
DINOv2 step 0 exceeded the five-second envelope

families.name: WRONG_PRIVATE_DATASET_MOUNT_TEMPLATE
families.signature: Code assumes /kaggle/input/<slug> instead of the evidenced owner-qualified private mount.
families.prevention: Generate and statically require /kaggle/input/datasets/<owner>/<slug>; a remote preflight-only kernel must attest it before scientific launch.

incidents.error: Step0Error: exact DINOv2 private-dataset manifest missing

families.name: PRIVATE_DATASET_403_WITHOUT_TARGET_CHANGE
families.signature: Repeated authenticated download/status attempts return 403 for the same private target.
families.prevention: Stop after the first confirmed 403; disclose the exact target and use owner UI/manual retrieval or change the authorization/target.

incidents.error: Authenticated status, files, and metadata calls returned 403 and the owner listing omitted the slug.
Private dataset CLI download returned 403; owner manually downloaded v7 and v8.
403 Client Error: Forbidden for url: https://api.kaggle.com/v1/kernels.KernelsApiService/GetKernel
incidents.evidence: The first remote metadata pull for the exact v3 target returned 403; it was not retried.

families.name: CROSS_KERNEL_PREFLIGHT_SCOPE_LEAK
families.signature: A dedicated preflight kernel sees the exact dataset, but a different scientific kernel ID with nominally identical metadata mounts no dataset.
families.prevention: Remote mount attestation is valid only for the same kernel ID that will execute science; promote a passing preflight kernel lineage instead of transferring its attestation to another kernel.

incidents.error: Step0Error: exact DINOv2 private-dataset manifest missing
incidents.evidence: The separate mount-preflight kernel passed at 0.054277081 s, but scientific kernel g02-dinov2-r5-cpu-run-v1 version 3 mounted no manifest.

families.name: KERNEL_TITLE_ID_SLUG_DRIFT
families.signature: The Kaggle CLI warns that the title does not resolve to the declared ID and launches under a title-derived slug.
families.prevention: Static guard must require the normalized kernel title to equal the declared ID slug before push; the push receipt's URL is authoritative.

incidents.warning: Your kernel title does not resolve to the specified id. This may result in surprising behavior.

families.name: DATASET_OWNERSHIP_REGISTRY_STALE
families.signature: A dataset slug is created and used by a lane but never added to dataset_ownership, so the guard's ownership check cannot bind it to any lane.
families.prevention: Adding a dataset_ownership entry is mandatory in the same change that creates or first pushes a new dataset slug. check_registry_freshness.py fails closed if any onebitbrain/* slug referenced in LIVE_STATE.md is absent from dataset_ownership.

incidents.error: FAIL_REGISTRY_STALE: onebitbrain/g02-cellect-r7-separation-v1 and onebitbrain/g02-dinov2-r5-gpu-assets-v1 referenced in LIVE_STATE.md with zero dataset_ownership coverage
incidents.evidence: reports/g02/screening/tiered_surface/kaggle_prelaunch/check_registry_freshness.py (run 2026-07-30, pre-fix output); both slugs are the exact GPU bake-off datasets used by the most recent CELLECT and DINOv2 GPU kernel pushes.

families.name: GUARD_NOT_STRUCTURALLY_ENFORCED
families.signature: kaggle_prelaunch_guard.py exists and covers KFG-01..17, but nothing prevents a kernel push that never invokes it: no git hook, no wrapper script, and no call site outside its own directory.
families.prevention: Treat `python3 kaggle_prelaunch_guard.py --kernel-dir <dir> --contract <contract.json> --registry KAGGLE_FAILURE_REGISTRY.json --phase static` (exit 0) as a mandatory precondition of every kernel push, recorded by receipt hash in the pushing node's report. No push may cite 'guard exists' without a fresh receipt for that exact kernel_dir and contract.

incidents.error: zero external call sites for kaggle_prelaunch_guard.py; only .sample git hooks present in .git/hooks and every vendored external/*/.git/hooks
incidents.evidence: grep -rln "kaggle_prelaunch_guard" excluding its own directory returned no matches; `ls .git/hooks` shows only *.sample files (2026-07-30 audit).
